title: config/agents.yaml and the operator's agents.yaml
description: The agent profiles (agents.md, "Agent profiles", D-498; F-141 D2): a profile name to the adapter that runs it, and optionally a model, arguments that come after bl's own, and environment variables. Steps and `--agent` name a profile. The operator's file is patched over the shop's, so it can add an argument to one profile.
